freePlan.limits: Academic access available for students, not a public free plan.

plans.name: Subscription / Perpetual license (Architect, Landmark, Spotlight, Fundamentals variants)

keyLimits.en: Pricing varies by product line (Architect, Landmark, Spotlight, Fundamentals) and by subscription vs. perpetual-license path; not published as a fixed list price.

addOns.en: Vectorworks Service Select: annual software-service plan for perpetual-license holders, included free for subscription customers.

cautions.en: No published price list on the official site; a reseller/quote process determines the final price by product variant, region, and license type.

capabilities.en: Integrated 3D CAD/BIM modeling across architecture, landscape, lighting, and scenic design.
Native BIM authoring with project documentation tools.
Specialist product lines for different disciplines: Architect, Landmark, Spotlight, Fundamentals.
Cloud services integration alongside desktop modeling.

limitations.en: No public price list; buyers must go through sales or a reseller for a quote.
Service Select (support/updates plan) availability varies by country.

reason.en: Competing 3D CAD tool used across architecture and design workflows.

unknowns: No numeric pricing found anywhere on official pages; third-party estimator sites give ranges but are not treated as proof.
Desktop OS platform support (Windows/Mac specifics) not confirmed from the pages read.
